name: WhisperX
description: Production-ready Telegram inline whisper bot. Send private, self-destructing, one-time, anonymous whispers — text and media — straight from Telegram's inline mode.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection string. Use MongoDB Atlas (https://cloud.mongodb.com) — Heroku no longer hosts a native MongoDB add-on. Example: mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster0.xxxx.mongodb.net

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user ID (get it from @userinfobot). Comma-separated for multiple admins.

ADMIN_IDS.description: Additional admin Telegram user IDs, comma-separated (optional).

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Private supergroup ID for admin logs (e.g. -1001234567890). Create a supergroup, add the bot as admin, then forward a message from it to @userinfobot to get the ID.

METADATA_ONLY_LOGS.description: Set to 'true' to strip message content from admin logs.

WORKERS.description: Pyrogram internal worker count (NOT a Heroku dyno count). Default 4 — controls in-process coroutine workers.

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Per-user inline query rate limit (queries per minute).

CLEANUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Background cleanup worker interval in seconds.

requirements: Dynos: Basic ($7/dyno-month) or higher. This formation uses Basic dynos, which are supported on Heroku Teams. Eco dynos are NOT supported on Heroku Teams.
